Sam: Thinking of trying a pub-quiz + snack swap next Thursday at 5:30? Short rounds, 30 mins max.
Priya: Love! Works for me. Can we do two rounds (general + pop culture)?
Jorge: I'm in. I can put together 15 QT. Also down to bring chips.
Mei: I can bake something small (vegan brownies?).
Sam: Sweet. Snack swap idea: everyone brings one shareable item, label allergens.
Priya: I'll make a tiny sign-up table in the calendar invite.
Jorge: Team size? Thinking we split into teams of 4.
Mei: That works. If low turnout, we can pair folks up.
Ops: FYI I reserved the cafe space for 5:15-6:15. Chairs/tables confirmed.
Sam: Amazing, thanks Ops :pray:. Planning: 5:15 doors, 5:30 round 1, 5:50 round 2, 6:05 winners announced.
Priya: Prizes? Stickers + a ridiculous trophy?
Jorge: I vote ridiculous trophy. I'll bring a small bag of candy for the winners.
Mei: Note: I'm gluten-free so I'll mark my baked item as GF.
Sam: Please react to this thread: :thumbsup: attending, :tada: bringing snack, :question: happy to help write questions.
Jorge: Reacted (attending + snack).
Priya: Reacted (attending + organizer).
Mei: Reacted (attending + snack).
EventsBot: Created event: https://calendar.example.com/event/quiz-snack-swap-1751234567. Reminder scheduled 24h before.
Sam: Cool. Quick ask: volunteers to do question-mastering? Two people needed.
Priya: I'll co-host questions with Jorge.
Jorge: Yep, happy to run questions.
Sam: Great. See you all there :beer: :trophy:
